name_for_human: NIC Info — Sri Lankan NIC Decoder
description_for_human: Free online tool to decode Sri Lankan NIC numbers and extract birthday, gender, and age. Supports old (9-digit) and new (12-digit) formats. 100% private.
description_for_model: A utility tool that parses Sri Lankan National Identity Card (NIC) numbers to extract encoded personal information. Supports both old format (9 digits + V/X, used before 2016) and new format (12 digits, introduced in 2016). The tool extracts: birthday / date of birth (NIC to DOB, from day-of-year encoding), gender (days 1-366 = male, 501-866 = female), and calculates precise age (years, months, days). All processing is client-side JavaScript for complete privacy — no data is stored or transmitted to any server.
